settings.comment: If set to false, hay beds cannot be used to set a player's spawn (regardless of the type of amulet being worn).
If set to false, rusty gear amulets cannot be used to set a player's spawn (only temporal gear amulets can be used).
If set to true, amulets will have a chance to break when a player respawns upon death.
If set to false, when a player breaks the bed, the spawn point will not be removed.
The chance (%) that a rusty gear amulet will break when a player respawns upon death.
The chance (%) that a temporal gear amulet will break when a player respawns upon death
